# Crunchbase.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/crunchbase-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/crunchbase-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects company and public person datasets from Crunchbase.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Crunchbase in 2025](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-crunchbase)
- **Code:** [`crunchbase.py`](crunchbase.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Company pages](results/company.json) · [Investor pages](results/person.json)

## What it scrapes

- Crunchbase.com company data including employees and all cards.
- Crunchbase.com public person data.

## Functions

- `scrape_company(url, _retries=0)` → `CompanyData`: scrape crunchbase company page for organization and employee data
- `scrape_person(url, _retries=0)` → `Dict`

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import crunchbase


async def main():
    company = await crunchbase.scrape_company("https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/tesla-motors/people")
    person = await crunchbase.scrape_person("https://www.crunchbase.com/person/elon-musk")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`CompanyData`**: `organization`, `employees`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`crunchbase.py`](crunchbase.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/crunchbase-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_company_scraping`, `test_person_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
